ideas.title: Investigating the Impact of Federal Funding Freeze on Child Care Services
ideas.description: This story would investigate the effects of the federal funding freeze on child care services in Minnesota
ideas.angle: Data analysis and public records review
questions: What is the current state of child care funding in Minnesota?
How is the federal funding freeze affecting child care services?
ideas.insight: I believe this story is important because it affects vulnerable populations, including low-income families and children. By analyzing data and reviewing public records, we can uncover the impact of the funding freeze and hold accountable those responsible.
